requirement: Auto-merge reads a PR again while GitHub still computes its mergeability instead of turning a green PR away

oracle.invariant: A first read with mergeable: null followed by a clean read reaches the exact-head gate and merges after one wait. A PR whose mergeability stays unknown after four reads is reported as mergeability-unknown and never reaches the gate or the merge. A closed PR is read once, without retries. Every earlier guard (draft, reviews, head change, expired verdict, App token) still blocks the merge.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: mergeability still being computed is read again before the PR is judged
mergeability that stays unknown is reported as such and never reaches the gate
automatic merge is restricted to ready same-repository develop PRs with known clean mergeability
draft, review, branch and head changes after the gate prevent merge
a verdict expiring during the last review reads never reaches merge
